D: A mountain rescue climber battles thieves in the Rocky Mountains.
P: Serve the mains when the money cases fall from the plane.
S: the ranger hut, waiting out the storm

Smoked trout whipped with cream cheese, lemon, dill and horseradish, spread thick on rye crackers with pickled red onion on top. Flake 250g hot-smoked trout, removing any skin and bones. Blitz half with 200g cream cheese, the juice of half a lemon, 2 tsp horseradish and pepper, then fold in the rest of the trout with chopped dill so it stays chunky. Slice half a red onion thin and soak in 3 tbsp white wine vinegar with a pinch of sugar for 20 minutes. Spread thick on rye crackers and top with the pickled onion.
the thermos at the ranger hut

Roast pumpkin soup with onion, garlic and stock, blitzed silky and finished with cream, poured from a thermos into mugs with toasted pepitas. Heat the oven to 200C. Toss 1kg diced pumpkin with oil and salt and roast 30 minutes until caramelised. Soften 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves in butter for 5 minutes, add the pumpkin and 750ml chicken stock and simmer 10 minutes. Blitz until smooth and stir in 100ml cream. Toast 40g pepitas in a dry pan for 3 minutes. Pour the soup into a warmed thermos and scatter pepitas on each mug.

Thin-sliced beef marinated in soy, brown sugar, Worcestershire and cracked pepper, slow-dried in the oven until chewy, packed for the climb. Freeze 800g topside for 1 hour, then slice 3mm thick across the grain. Mix 100ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp cracked black pepper and 1 tsp garlic powder. Marinate the beef overnight. Pat dry and lay on wire racks over trays. Dry at 70C with the oven door slightly open for 4 hours until leathery but still bendy. Cool and store airtight.
M: Rescue station chuck chilli with cornbread
the rescue station after a long day

Chunks of beef chuck braised with chilli, cumin, tomato and kidney beans until tender, with sour cream, cheddar and warm buttered cornbread. Brown 1.2kg beef chuck in 3cm chunks in batches in a heavy pot. Add 2 diced onions and 4 garlic cloves and cook 5 minutes, then 2 tbsp chilli powder, 2 tsp cumin and 2 tbsp tomato paste. Add 800g crushed tomatoes and 250ml beef stock, cover and braise at 150C for 2.5 hours. Stir in a drained 400g tin kidney beans for the last 20 minutes. Bake a cornbread mix in a hot buttered pan at 200C for 20 minutes. Serve with sour cream and cheddar.
Rump steak rubbed with salt, pepper and rosemary, grilled over hot coals 4 minutes a side, rested on a board. Potatoes wrapped in foil with butter and baked in the coals for 45 minutes.
W: the mountain lodge after the rescue
Thin pastry rolled around apples, raisins, cinnamon and buttery breadcrumbs, baked at 190C until golden, icing sugar and cream.
K: Dark rum stirred into hot water with spiced butter and brown sugar, for the grown-ups.

m.how: Wrap 4 potatoes with a knob of butter each in foil and bake in the coals for 45 minutes. Rub 4 rump steaks with salt, pepper and chopped rosemary. Grill over hot coals for 4 minutes a side and rest on a board.

w.note: the mountain lodge after the rescue
w.how: Toss 4 sliced green apples with 60g sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon, 50g raisins and 40g breadcrumbs fried in 20g butter. Layer 8 sheets filo, brushing each with 60g melted butter, pile the apple along one edge and roll up. Bake at 190C for 35 minutes, dust with icing sugar and serve with 200ml cream.

d.how: Beat 80g soft butter with 80g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and a pinch of nutmeg and cloves. Put a heaped tablespoon in each of 4 mugs with 45ml dark rum and top with 150ml boiling water. Stir until melted.
